name: usage-band
description: Band above the prompt showing the model and effort, context %, cache hit rate, and session and weekly limits, with a click-to-open side pane that breaks down context, cache, tools, skills and MCP

showCache.title: Show cache
showCache.description: Share of the last response's input read from the prompt cache on the band, and the cache read and write token counts in the pane.

showTools.title: Show tools
showTools.description: Pane section: the tools in the window and their share of it.

showSkills.title: Show skills
showSkills.description: Pane section: the skills listed in context and their share of the window.

showMcp.title: Show MCP
showMcp.description: Pane section: the MCP tools by server and the share of the window the loaded ones use.

showSession.title: Show session limit
showSession.description: The five-hour rate-limit window and when it resets (subscriptions only).

showWeek.title: Show weekly limit
showWeek.description: The seven-day rate-limit window and when it resets (subscriptions only).
